movie.title: Say a Little Prayer
movie.overview: Three best friends recite an ancient prayer to the patron saint of “all things lost” to find their true loves, unleashing an unexpected turn of events that will put their friendship to the test.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: Hoping to discover their true loves, three best friends recite an ancient prayer to the patron saint of lost things, setting off a chain reaction of unexpected romance, comedic complications, and emotional tests for their bond.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: Three lifelong best friends decide to take a leap of faith by reciting an ancient prayer dedicated to the patron saint of lost things in hopes of finding true love. Their spiritual appeal yields quick results, but the romantic opportunities that emerge bring unintended chaos, misunderstandings, and hidden desires into their lives. As their new relationship dynamics threaten to tear their close-knit bond apart, the trio must confront what they truly want in love and life. Ultimately, they realize that before finding their soulmates, they must first protect the friendship that has always anchored them.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: In this heartfelt romantic comedy-drama, three inseparable best friends find themselves stuck in personal ruts and yearning for genuine romantic connections. Looking for a breakthrough, they decide to test an old tradition by reciting an ancient prayer to the patron saint of lost things to help them locate their true soulmates. To their astonishment, the ritual seems to work almost instantly, introducing new suitors and unexpected romantic prospects into their daily routines. However, as these new relationships take off, the sudden influx of romance brings unforeseen complications that alter the dynamic between the trio. Jealousy, miscommunication, and competing romantic priorities begin to brew, creating rift after rift within their once-unshakable circle. Each friend is forced to navigate their personal journey of self-discovery while grappling with whether their newly found loves are truly worth risking their lifelong bond. A major confrontation forces the trio to reflect on their choices and evaluate the true meaning of devotion and honesty. Through tears, laughter, and hard truths, the group learns that love isn't just about finding a partner, but also about cherishing the people who have stood by you all along. Ultimately, the friends work to heal their rift, embracing both the messiness of love and the endurance of their deep-seated friendship.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: When three best friends reach a crossroads in their love lives, they turn to a legendary tradition: reciting an ancient prayer dedicated to the patron saint of all things lost. Expecting little more than a moment of shared fun, they are stunned when a series of unexpected encounters and sudden romantic opportunities turn their world upside down. However, finding true love proves far more complicated than simply asking for it. As secrets emerge and romantic entanglements escalate, the trio's deep-rooted friendship is put to the ultimate test. 'Say a Little Prayer' is a charming, humorous, and deeply resonant story about searching for romance, discovering oneself, and learning that the most valuable connections are often the ones we've had all along.

story_structure.climax: The emotional tension reaches a breaking point during a major confrontation where the friends must face the fallout of their choices and test the limits of their loyalty.
story_structure.conflict: The ritual triggers a series of unexpected events and chaotic romantic developments that throw their lives into disarray.
story_structure.resolution: The friends gain clarity on love, self-worth, and devotion, ultimately learning the true value of their relationship and moving forward with renewed understanding.
story_structure.introduction: Three best friends, hoping to find true love, discover and recite an ancient prayer dedicated to the patron saint of lost things.
story_structure.risingAction: As romantic complications escalate and secrets surface, personal desires clash, putting severe strain on the trio's lifelong bond.
